rules.regime: QQQ daily close > 165-day SMA (prior close) -> TQQQ, else BIL
rules.stop: stop_dist = clip(0.70 * ATR14(TQQQ daily, prior close), 2.5%, 4%); TQQQ close < session open * (1 - stop_dist) -> BIL at next bar open, out for the rest of the session and the night
rules.partial: 50% QQQ / 50% BIL after the stop (tested, does not help)

diagnostics.n_stops_note: n_stops counts the whole warm-up+test panel (2016-2026); the 2017-2026 test-window counts are 204 for atr70_cap4_bil vs 153 for the winner
